Since the deadline cannot be met with any available production mode (basic finishes 30 min late, premium finishes 75 min late), and the budget/deadline are fixed constraints, I must stop the task.

The estimate shows the plan is within budget (8 units ≤ 10) but exceeds the deadline by 30 minutes (finishes at 17:06 vs deadline 16:36). The premium alternative is even worse (both over budget and over deadline).

The deadline is fixed and cannot be modified. The basic mode already uses the minimum durations available. Let me check if there's any way to reduce time — the material preparation (10 min), script finalize (20 min), video edit basic (45 min), and review (15 min) are all fixed steps. There's no faster option available.

Since the deadline cannot be met with any available production mode (basic finishes 30 min late, premium finishes 75 min late), and the budget/deadline are fixed constraints, I must stop the task.
